decisions.reason: The cleaning soap builds directly on the firm's surface-treatment knowledge and complements its floors, so it can assimilate market feedback and keep the item at low cost.
The maintenance oil line rests on the firm's own surface-treatment R&D and strengthens aftersales ties with installers and homeowners.
Care products for oiled floors match the firm's oiled finishes, so its existing know-how lets it interpret results and refine the line.
The moisture-protection underlay is a natural system accessory that the firm's technical installation expertise can support and improve.
High-density foam underlay is further from the wood-processing core but remains a cheap, standard system component that rounds out the accessory range.
The oak parquet line sits at the heart of the firm's wood-processing expertise and production base, where its absorptive capacity is strongest.
